title: Social Manor | KEY.co
description_expanded: Just 250 steps from the powdery sands of the Gulf, this extraordinary 30A retreat delivers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and laid-back coastal charm. Designed for unforgettable gatherings, the home features eight spacious bedrooms and ten bathrooms across an open, light-filled layout. Gulf views, a rooftop terrace, and a private elevator add an elevated touch, while the expansive game room, complete with pool table, foosball, and a wet bar, ensures entertainment for all ages. With a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, every beach town from Seaside to Grayton is effortlessly within reach. Outside, the private resort-style pool and spa anchor a backyard made for entertaining. An outdoor kitchen with a Wolf grill, large-screen TV, and ample seating creates the perfect setting for alfresco dining or game-day fun. Whether you're savoring a sunset cocktail on the rooftop deck or starting your day with a scenic bike ride along 30A, every moment here is crafted for indulgence and ease. From serene mornings to lively evenings, this exceptional home promises an unparalleled coastal experience.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
